sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
maudhui: Every Member of Parliament shall be required to take and subscribe before the National Assembly the oath of allegiance before he begins to take part in the business of the National Assembly, save that a Member may take part in the election of the Speaker before taking the oath.
